description: A sprite sheet of NINE separate small props arranged in a 3 by 3 grid, each small and centered in its own cell: cracked wooden ship's wheel, open wooden treasure chest full of glowing blue rune crystals, severed crimson-purple club-shaped squid tentacle tip lying limp, barnacle-covered iron cannon, broken tarnished silver seagull figurehead, old brass ship lantern with a dim warm yellow flame wrapped in faint sickly sea-green ghost mist, corroded green-tinged brass machine part tightly wrapped in thin glowing scarlet-red threads, jagged black abyss rock spire with barnacles, pile of splintered ship planks and rope, drawn in straight FRONT VIEW like the reference (facing the camera, slight top-down), thick dark outline, soft cel shading, every object fully separate on a plain flat solid bright magenta (#FF00FF) chroma-key background with wide empty space around it, no ground, no shadow puddles, no text, no characters

style_image.usage_description: Copy ONLY the art style of this reference: chunky chibi pixel art, thick dark outline on every shape, soft cel shading, front-facing view. Do not copy these objects or their colors.
